description: Composite 4×4 TEM figure of rolled Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe low-density steels with one row per beryllium level: (a) 0Be, (b) 0.5Be, (c) 1.0Be, (d) 1.5Be. Column 1: bright-field matrix images with a dashed circle marking the SADP aperture — (a₁) 5 µm bar, (b₁) and (c₁) 2 µm, (d₁) 500 nm. Column 2: austenite selected-area diffraction patterns — (a₂) zone axis [1̄14] with spots 022, 311, 3̄11 labelled γ-Fe; (b₂) [1̄11] with 220, 02̄2, 2̄02; (d₂) [013] with 131, 1̄31, 200; (c₂) is instead a dark-field image of a string of fine bright particles along a banded feature, with a dashed box linked by yellow lines to (c₃). Column 3: bright-field images of coarse carbide/Be2C particles, 500 nm–1 µm bars. Column 4: carbide diffraction patterns — (a₄) [001] with 010, 110, 100 labelled κ-carbide; (b₄) and (d₄) [1̄12] and (c₄) [011], all with spots 200/11̄1/111 or 3̄11/2̄20/11̄1, labelled Be2C. (d₁) marks GB (grain boundary) in yellow with red arrows to boundary precipitates. The figure argues the matrix is austenite in every alloy, 0Be precipitates are κ-carbide whereas 0.5–1.5Be form Be2C, and Be2C coarsens with increasing Be.
measured_quantities: diffraction spot indices (hkl) with zone axes

observations.observation: The figure is a 4×4 panel grid; each row is one beryllium content — row 1 (a) = 0Be, row 2 (b) = 0.5Be, row 3 (c) = 1.0Be, row 4 (d) = 1.5Be steel.
Matrix diffraction patterns (a₂), (b₂) and (d₂) are all labelled γ-Fe with zone axes [1̄14], [1̄11] and [013] respectively, identifying the matrix as austenite.
(a₄) is labelled 'κ-carbide' with zone axis [001] and indexed spots 010, 110 and 100.
Panels (b₄), (c₄) and (d₄) are labelled 'Be2C' with zone axes [1̄12], [011] and [1̄12] respectively.
Scale bars in the matrix column differ by alloy: 5 µm in (a₁), 2 µm in (b₁) and (c₁), and 500 nm in (d₁); the carbide column uses 500 nm (a₃) and 1 µm (b₃, c₃, d₃).
(c₂) is a dark-field image (dark background, bright elongated particles in a row) rather than a diffraction pattern, unlike the column-2 panels of the other rows.
Panel (d₁) annotates a grain boundary with yellow lines labelled 'GB' and red arrows pointing to precipitates located on that boundary.
Every bright-field panel carries a dashed blue circle labelled SADP marking the position of the selected-area diffraction aperture.
The caption states that (a₃), (b₃), (c₃) and (d₃) show the microstructure of carbide in 0Be, 0.5Be, 1.0Be and 1.5Be steel respectively.
The citing sentence states that the matrix is primarily austenite based on selected aperture diffraction in (a₂), (b₂) and (d₂).
The citing sentence states that the precipitates in 0Be steel are κ-carbides, while Be2C compounds were observed in 0.5Be, 1.0Be and 1.5Be steel.

The citing sentence states that from the selective-aperture diffraction in (b₄), (c₄) and (d₄) the size of Be2C gradually increases with increasing Be content; no particle sizes are printed on the panels themselves.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM image of 0Be steel matrix showing overlapping deformation bands/laths; a dashed blue circle marks the SADP aperture; scale bar 5 µm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 0Be matrix; zone axis [1̄14]; red-indexed spots 022, 311, 3̄11 and the label γ-Fe.
Bright-field TEM image of a coarse carbide particle in 0Be steel, with internal dislocation lines/curved defects; dashed circle marks the SADP aperture; scale bar 500 nm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 0Be precipitate; zone axis [001]; spots 010, 110, 100; labelled κ-carbide.
Bright-field TEM matrix image of 0.5Be steel with a marked SADP circle; scale bar 2 µm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 0.5Be matrix; zone axis [1̄11]; spots 220, 02̄2, 2̄02; labelled γ-Fe.
Bright-field TEM image of a carbide/Be2C precipitate region in 0.5Be steel with a marked SADP circle; scale bar 1 µm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 0.5Be precipitate; zone axis [1̄12]; spots 3̄11, 2̄20, 11̄1; labelled Be2C.
Bright-field TEM matrix image of 1.0Be steel showing a banded/heterogeneous structure; scale bar 2 µm.
Dark-field TEM image on a dark background showing a chain of fine bright particles along a planar band; a dashed blue box marks one particle and yellow lines connect it to (c₃); scale bar 5 µm.
Bright-field TEM image of coarse Be2C particles in 1.0Be steel (yellow-bordered panel), dashed circle marking the SADP aperture; scale bar 1 µm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 1.0Be precipitate; zone axis [011]; spots 200, 11̄1, 111; labelled Be2C.
Bright-field TEM image of 1.5Be steel; yellow lines labelled GB mark a grain boundary, red arrows point to precipitates along it, dashed circle marks the SADP aperture; scale bar 500 nm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 1.5Be matrix; zone axis [013]; spots 131, 1̄31, 200; labelled γ-Fe.
Bright-field TEM image of elongated Be2C precipitate(s) in 1.5Be steel with a marked SADP circle; scale bar 1 µm.
Selected-area diffraction pattern of the 1.5Be precipitate; zone axis [1̄12]; spots 3̄11, 2̄20, 11̄1; labelled Be2C.
